name: Napa Valley

contains: Oak Knoll District of Napa Valley

climate: Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.
keyfacts: Napa Valley was established as the nation's second AVA in 1981 and covers all of Napa County except the portion northeast of Putah Creek and Lake Berryessa.
The southern end is coolest, with marine breezes crossing San Pablo Bay, while farther up the valley the ocean has less influence and summers are warmer.

notes: Napa is known above all for Cabernet Sauvignon, with strong black fruit flavors.
Napa Chardonnay is often associated with pineapple notes.
Napa Zinfandel is plummy and intense, with red berry, cedar and vanilla, often in a claret style.

blurb.text: California's first AVA and the nation's second, in a Mediterranean climate. Cabernet Sauvignon is the main grape in Napa County, followed by Chardonnay and Merlot. Napa gained wide recognition at the Paris Wine Tasting of 1976.
